channel.title: John DeWitt on The Anti-Federalist Library
channel.description: Recent content in John DeWitt on The Anti-Federalist Library

item.title: John DeWitt I
item.description: Argues that the centralization of power in the federal government would diminish state authority and individual liberties.

item.title: John DeWitt II
item.description: Warns that the size and complexity of a large republic under the proposed Constitution would make it difficult to protect the rights and interests of its citizens effectively.

item.title: John DeWitt III
item.description: Rejects the need for a new Constitution, asserting that state governments are fully capable of preserving order and governance without the need for a centralized national system.
